description: This file declares the class OpenCDMSessionPrivate, which manages a private implementation of an OpenCDM session, including license handling, key management, and session control. It also includes necessary headers and defines the interface for session operations.

classes.name: OpenCDMSessionPrivate
classes.description: A class implementing a private OpenCDM session, handling license requests, key management, and session lifecycle, inheriting from OpenCDMSession and IMediaKeysClient.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request events with specified key session ID, message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal events with specified key session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in key statuses for a given key session ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session, with an overload accepting a boolean parameter.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request with specified data type, init data, and CDM data.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with a license.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key ID is contained within the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: addProtectionMeta
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a buffer, with an overload accepting multiple parameters.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the key status for a given key.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Returns the last DRM error code.
